> Erdős [Er76d] conjectured a stronger statement: if $n_k$ is the $k$th powerful number, then $n_{k+2} - n_k > n_k^c$ for some constant $c > 0$. [Er76d] Erdős, P., Problems and results on number theoretic properties of consecutive integers and related questions. Proceedings of the Fifth Manitoba Conference on Numerical Mathematics (Univ. Manitoba, Winnipeg, Man., 1975) (1976), 25-44.
